result:
Lane finished. The handback task — resolving the conflict — is done, and along the way two blockers surfaced that belong to the fleet, not to this branch.

## The merge

Both conflicts were one collision: `lane/localtime` added `jobs/localtime.sh` sourcing and this lane added `jobs/window.sh`, to the same two preamble lines. Both intents kept whole — master's `say_time_s` tick log in `board.sh:28` with `. "$SELF/window.sh"` under it, and both sources on `status.sh`'s preamble. One line beyond the mechanical resolution, and it belongs to the merge: the page header now promises every time on it is local, so `status.sh`'s `dispatch DEFERRED until …` goes through `local_ts`. The UTC instants inside `WINDOW_WHY`/`WINDOW_FACTS` keep their `Z` and stay data.

**Why attempt 1 didn't finish:** it did finish — it was audited, green and marked ready. The base moved under it. That's recorded in NOTES.md as a stale attempt rather than a failed one; nothing it carried was re-opened.

PR #155: `MERGEABLE`, ready, `fold-ready`, `needs-rebase` off, `Files:` matching the diff exactly, tree clean.

## Two blockers, neither this branch's

**1. Master's `jobs selftest` CI is red** — green at `baa8b649a5`, failing from `4eb641e777` (the fold of #145 `lane/foldregress`) onward. Same CI runner: this head **551 passed / 10 failed**, master **501 / 10**, the same 10 names, all in `fold.sh`'s `regression-accepted` override. So this branch adds 50 passing checks and zero failures. `fold.sh`'s `ci_green()` requires every check SUCCESS, so **nothing can fold** — #156, #153, #152, #149, #146 are all in the same position.

**2. `territory.toml` double-claims `hw/xbox/nv2a/nv2a.c`** — in `[free]` (line 532) *and* in `[lane.vblank65]` (line 575), from `f497b85c81`. This fails `preflight.sh` for every lane. I caught it because preflight **passed** on my previous head and failed on the next with only NOTES.md changed between them; preflight reads that file from `origin/board`, so the move wasn't in my tree. `--allow-tracker` doesn't cover it — that licenses the tracker-file step, not the file claim.

I didn't fix either. `fold.sh` is unheld now that `lane.foldregress` retired, but it isn't on this PR's `Files:` line, and taking it silently is the collision the board can't see. `territory.toml` is forbidden outright.

The board request is written out in NOTES.md and delivered twice, since the sandbox refused a write to `$DISPATCH_DIR/board-requests/`: as `[lane.windowbudget] blocked:` comments on #155, and as a direct message to the host session that arbitrates the tracker.

One open question for you, not blocking: the `jobs selftest` red needs its own lane holding `docs/testing/jobs/fold.sh` and `selftest.d/86-fold-regressed.sh`. I've reported it rather than dispatched it — that's the board's call.
